title: Delicious Algerian Paella
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Algeria, this paella recipe combines the classic Spanish dish with North African spices and ingredients.

ingredients.name: Flaky Zesty Cod
ingredients.notes: Make sure the cod is flaky and at room temperature before cooking

ingredients.name: Algerian Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of spices and herbs typical of Algerian cuisine

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the Algerian seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Add the flaky zesty cod and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the Algerian paella rice and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
